From 14533a5a6c12e8d7de79d309d4085bf186058fe1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michael Kao <michael.kao@mediatek.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2020 20:15:35 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] thermal/drivers/mediatek: Fix bank number settings on mt8183

MT8183_NUM_ZONES should be set to 1
because MT8183 doesn't have multiple banks.

Fixes: a4ffe6b52d27 ("thermal: mediatek: add support for MT8183")
Signed-off-by: Michael Kao <michael.kao@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Hsin-Yi Wang <hsinyi@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Daniel Lezcano <daniel.lezcano@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200323121537.22697-6-michael.kao@mediatek.com

diff --git a/drivers/thermal/mtk_thermal.c b/drivers/thermal/mtk_thermal.c
index 76e30603d4d5..6b7ef1993d7e 100644
--- a/drivers/thermal/mtk_thermal.c
+++ b/drivers/thermal/mtk_thermal.c
@@ -211,6 +211,9 @@ enum {
 /* The total number of temperature sensors in the MT8183 */
 #define MT8183_NUM_SENSORS	6
 
+/* The number of banks in the MT8183 */
+#define MT8183_NUM_ZONES               1
+
 /* The number of sensing points per bank */
 #define MT8183_NUM_SENSORS_PER_ZONE	 6
 
@@ -497,7 +500,7 @@ static const struct mtk_thermal_data mt7622_thermal_data = {
  */
 static const struct mtk_thermal_data mt8183_thermal_data = {
 	.auxadc_channel = MT8183_TEMP_AUXADC_CHANNEL,
-	.num_banks = MT8183_NUM_SENSORS_PER_ZONE,
+	.num_banks = MT8183_NUM_ZONES,
 	.num_sensors = MT8183_NUM_SENSORS,
 	.vts_index = mt8183_vts_index,
 	.cali_val = MT8183_CALIBRATION,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/thermal/mtk_thermal.c`**
   - Added a new definition for the number of zones in the MT8183:
     ```c
     #define MT8183_NUM_ZONES 1
     ```
   - Updated the `mt8183_thermal_data` structure to set the `num_banks` field to `MT8183_NUM_ZONES` instead of `MT8183_NUM_SENSORS_PER_ZONE`:
     ```c
     .num_banks = MT8183_NUM_ZONES,
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification establishes that the MT8183 thermal driver should recognize that there is only one bank (zone) for temperature sensing, correcting the previous assumption that there were multiple banks. This change ensures that the thermal management system accurately reflects the hardware capabilities of the MT8183, which only has a single bank of sensors, thereby preventing potential misconfigurations or errors in thermal readings.

thermal/drivers/mediatek: Fix bank number settings on mt8183

MT8183_NUM_ZONES should be set to 1

Fixes: a4ffe6b52d27 ("thermal: mediatek: add support for MT8183")

Signed-off-by: Hsin-Yi Wang <hsinyi@chromium.org>

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200323121537.22697-6-michael.kao@mediatek.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly setting the number of banks (zones) for the MT8183 thermal driver to a value that implied multiple banks, when in fact the MT8183 only has one bank. This misconfiguration could lead to incorrect thermal management behavior, as the system would expect multiple banks of sensors that do not exist.

Here is the patch:

 static const struct mtk_thermal_data mt8183_thermal_data = {

-	.num_banks = MT8183_NUM_SENSORS_PER_ZONE,

```c

```
Reason:
The incorrect assignment of `.num_banks` to `MT8183_NUM_SENSORS_PER_ZONE` (which implies multiple banks) instead of the correct value of `1` for `MT8183_NUM_ZONES` leads to a misconfiguration in the thermal driver. This causes the system to expect multiple thermal zones, which do not exist in the MT8183, resulting in incorrect thermal management behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
.num_banks = MT8183_NUM_ZONES,
```
Reason:
By changing `.num_banks` to use `MT8183_NUM_ZONES`, which is correctly defined as `1`, the thermal driver is now configured to reflect the actual hardware capabilities of the MT8183. This ensures that the system correctly recognizes that there is only one bank of sensors, thus preventing any erroneous thermal management operations.
